control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: hazard report during a breakdown response on P-8303

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on P-8303 and TK-8311 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. P-8303 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 5 July 2014 a hazard report was recorded on P-8303 and TK-8311 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during a breakdown response; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
